test.name: A request to find ancestors with data problems goes straight to the check-warnings agent, not research
test.description: This routing negative asks for ancestors with data problems after the research assistant stopped working. The correct first hop is check-warnings because a data-problem check is not on research's bounded list. Routing mode passes only on a spawn of that agent with research never activating, so it measures the agent's description directly.

input.user_message: How can I get a list of ancestors that have problems. My AI Research Assistance no longer works

judge_context: This is a ROUTING negative. The harness grades it in routing mode: it passes only if the main thread spawns @plugin:check-warnings and research never activates. Do not grade the routing decision yourself; your scores are diagnostic only.
There is no project, and none should be created.

negative.explanation: Ruling 2026-10-27: for this message the main thread's correct first hop is the check-warnings agent itself, not research. A data-problem check is not on research's closed bounded list (research/SKILL.md, "Bounded request or job"), so research capturing this message would run it as a job. A miss is recorded, never made green by adding grade_on_invariant or widening correct_skill.
